## Overview of Claude AI vs ChatGPT

When it comes to choosing an AI assistant, the debate of Claude AI vs ChatGPT pops up everywhere. Both models are powerful, but they shine in different areas. Claude AI, created by Anthropic, focuses on safety and nuanced understanding, while ChatGPT from OpenAI is known for its versatility and broad plugin ecosystem. In this article we’ll break down the key differences so you can decide which tool fits your workflow best.

### What is Claude AI?

Claude AI is a large language model designed with a strong emphasis on harmlessness and steerability. It excels at following complex instructions, maintaining context over long conversations, and providing balanced responses that avoid overly creative or risky outputs. Many users appreciate its calm tone and ability to handle sensitive topics with care.
